subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Put the parts of a travel brochure in the right order
Listen to a message and decide True, False or Not Given
Use will, going to and the present continuous for the future

tf.s: On the bus trip, passengers buy a travel permit at the border.
tf.why: Yes! You need a travel permit at the border.

tf.s: The bus stops in Nizwa for a refreshment break.
tf.why: Right! It is a short 20-minute stop.

tf.s: The bus brochure begins with boarding the bus at Dubai bus station.
tf.why: Correct! Boarding at 7:30 am comes first.

tf.s: The bus has lunch in Nizwa.
tf.why: Nizwa is the refreshment stop; lunch is at Hayma.

tf.s: In a listening task, if the recording does not give the information, the answer is NG.
We read the statements after listening, not before.
tf.why: Read them first so you know what to listen for.

tf.s: 'I'll have the blue one' shows a decision made at the moment of speaking.
tf.why: Yes! 'Will' is used for quick decisions.

tf.s: 'I'm meeting my brother tomorrow' shows a fixed arrangement.
tf.why: Right! The present continuous shows arrangements.

tf.s: 'He is going to have an accident' cannot be used when we see a man driving too fast.
tf.why: We use 'going to' for a prediction based on what we can see.

tf.s: 'I promise I am working harder next year' is the best way to make a promise.
tf.why: For a promise we use 'will': 'I promise I will work harder.'

boxes.q: What do you need to buy at the border?
boxes.why: Travellers buy a travel permit at the border.

boxes.q: Where does the bus stop for a refreshment break?
boxes.why: The Nizwa stop is about 20 minutes.

boxes.q: What time does the bus leave Dubai bus station?
Which future form shows a promise?
o: I'll help you with your homework.

boxes.q: Choose: I promise I ___ harder next year.
Choose: I can't come because I ___ my parents tomorrow.
boxes.why: An arrangement uses the present continuous.

boxes.q: 'I'm going to watch TV, then go to bed' shows…
Choose: What do you think ___ in the next ten years?
boxes.why: Predictions about the future often use 'will'.

boxes.q: Why do we read the statements before listening?
o: to know what to listen for
boxes.why: Key words tell you what to listen for.

boxes.q: Which word means 'leave' at an airport?

mcq.q: Which paragraph begins the bus brochure?
o: paragraph c – boarding the bus at Dubai bus station
paragraph d – arriving at the hotel
mcq.why: The bus brochure order is c, e, g, b.

mcq.q: Which future form shows a fixed arrangement?

o: predictions, offers, promises and quick decisions

mcq.q: What kind of message do you listen to in this lesson?
o: a message on an answering machine
mcq.why: The traveller leaves a message about his trip.

mcq.q: That man is driving too fast. Complete: He ___ an accident soon.
mcq.why: We use 'going to' to predict from what we can see.

o: Cars will fly in the future.
Cars will to fly in the future.
Cars flying will in the future.
Cars will flew in the future.
mcq.why: 'Will' is followed by the base form of the verb.

mcq.q: Which sentence shows a decision made at the moment of speaking?
o: I am going to study medicine next year.

mcq.q: What is the difference between 'I'm meeting my brother tomorrow' and 'I'm going to meet my brother'?
o: The first is a fixed arrangement; the second is an intention
The first is past; the second is present
mcq.why: Present continuous = arrangement; going to = plan or intention.

mcq.q: Which clues help you put the bus brochure paragraphs in order?
o: times and words like 'after' and 'on arrival'
mcq.why: Time and sequence words show the order.

mcq.q: Why is 'She's meeting her friend later today' correct?
o: It is an arrangement for the near future
